purpose: Candidate architecture decision for independent G review. This packet records evidence and a choice; it is not a code acceptance, waiver, formal finding closure, or permission to change the guard before the owner decision.

source_frame.head: 75e1e60fb11738397074baff21872dcb91d18a0c
source_frame.note: Shared checkout was dirty and other authorized writers were active. This is path-digest-bound evidence, not a clean final source freeze.

question_for_g: Does public-surface completeness mean that exports are statically derivable from the current pure-declaration grammar, or that the source-declared API is proven usable by a controlled runtime consumer?

owner_and_authority.author_role: local candidate author; not an independent acceptor
owner_and_authority.external_authority_or_expiry_issuer: not applicable; no issuer, blanket waiver, expiry, or clock shift is proposed

pattern_pass.bucket: Same public-export completeness gate, one level deeper: the static resolver treats package/parent initializer imports as part of the purity proof even when they do not alter the finite export declaration.
pattern_pass.target: Keep unknown distinct from empty and retain adversarial/effectful-import refusal. Resolve the contract boundary before changing the gate.
pattern_pass.capability_status: The inventory/runtime verification relationship is unresolved; no formal public-surface closure is claimed.

observed_property_and_divergence.product_property: Inventory and release checks should identify supported public entrypoints and their usable export surface.
observed_property_and_divergence.current_gate_predicate: Every export count must be derivable by the finite static grammar after all imported modules and package initializers pass the no-execution/passive-binding audit.
observed_property_and_divergence.divergent_case: The current polisyos.common facade declares seven runtime exports and implements lazy __getattr__ with importlib. The static inventory marks that entrypoint incomplete, while the controlled runtime consumer resolves declared names. The full current denominator has 67 unique supported entrypoints and 5,300 runtime-declared names resolving, while the direct static evaluator reports 67 unresolved entrypoints and 67 incomplete_exports violations.

prototype.result: In a controlled package with literal __all__, an otherwise unused parent importlib import changes static resolution from complete to unknown while an actual subprocess import returns the same export/value before and after its removal. This isolates the dependency-slice divergence; it does not establish arbitrary import safety.

gate_loci: guardrails.py:_StaticExportResolver (1181-1187): source-only finite grammar; no execution
guardrails.py:_import_source (1541-1555): rejects external imports, including stdlib, while loading parent/package source
guardrails.py:_entrypoint_inventory (1876-1940): unresolved remains distinct from empty exports

current_static_census.result_scope: Direct invocation of the current inventory builder and public-surface contract evaluator; not a full native SOTA run.

runtime_and_removal_controls.runtime_result: 2 tests passed; current in-tree consumer checked 67 unique entrypoints and resolved 5,300 runtime-declared names. This is not an installed-wheel/sdist receipt and does not prove every name's owner identity or absence of extra unlisted attributes.
runtime_and_removal_controls.marker_retaining_removal_control: tests/repo_quality/architecture/test_public_surface_supported_entrypoint_inventory.py:186-295; altering/removing a supported export while retaining facade markers produces generated inventory drift. The existing effectful owner/__getattr__ controls in test_public_surface_export_resolution.py:509-569,652-691 refuse unsafe inference.

options_for_g.name: Ratify static-purity requirement
options_for_g.reuse_first: Keep the existing source-only resolver and hard gate.
options_for_g.impact: Migrate supported facades and all required dependency surfaces to the admitted pure-declaration grammar. The migration spans the current 67-entrypoint denominator; actual effort and deadline are not estimated. The public-surface row remains red until the native command passes.
options_for_g.risk: Strong no-execution property; broad facade and dependent API changes may be substantial.

options_for_g.name: Extend the existing static dependency-slice resolver
options_for_g.reuse_first: Retain the current static resolver, but derive a generic, bounded dependency slice for export declarations instead of treating every parent/import effect as export evidence.
options_for_g.impact: Prototype on a lazy facade and a dynamic/computed __all__ facade; preserve unknown for unsupported declarations and all effectful-owner/callback controls. Static correctness and future grammar maintenance remain the main cost.
options_for_g.risk: A broader parser/effect model can grow without bound and must not become an importlib-name whitelist.

options_for_g.name: Separate static declarations from runtime verification (candidate recommendation)
options_for_g.reuse_first: Keep extraction non-executing; report finite statically declared names separately from verified runtime exports. Use the existing runtime consumer as the behavioral side of the contract.
options_for_g.impact: At the chosen source freeze, compare generated declared names with runtime module.__all__, resolve every getattr, and verify mapped owner bindings. Keep non-finite declarations unknown. Run source tests plus exact installed wheel and rebuilt sdist consumers in the frozen supported profile.
options_for_g.risk: Requires G/architecture acceptance of the declaration-versus-runtime split; declaration alone must never yield a native pass.

options_for_g.name: Use runtime introspection to generate the inventory
options_for_g.reuse_first: No existing safe isolated runtime generator was evidenced in this review.
options_for_g.impact: Would execute all imported entrypoint code and become interpreter/backend/environment dependent; would need a supported sandbox and exact artifact-origin binding.
options_for_g.risk: No tested isolation contract is available; do not adopt absent a separate architecture/security decision.

recommended_candidate: Option 3, only after G and team-architecture accept the semantics. Do not edit guardrails, classify unknown as empty, or weaken a gate before that choice.
next_check_after_choice: Record the G/architecture choice and affected migration set; do not infer an expiry issuer or blanket waiver.
Prototype one lazy facade and one computed/dynamic __all__ facade against exact names, actual getattr, and owner mapping; retain current mutation/callback/effectful-import negatives.
Prove removal/change of an export fails while surface markers remain, and prove a runtime owner mismatch fails; also corrupt a generated inventory field and require the canonical --check to fail.
Freeze the complete 67-entrypoint source/profile denominator; regenerate and check inventory/docs; run exact source, installed-wheel, and rebuilt-sdist consumers with origin checks.
Run the exact public-surface and generated-drift SOTA rows, then the complete required native SOTA wave once on the resulting freeze. Record FAIL, ERROR, SKIP, and UNRUN separately.
formal_acceptance: none; independent G adjudication remains required
